---
DISPUTES:

- **Selective crediting of run-side signatures (consensus claim my data does not support).** Static (Claim 10), static_r2 (Claim 8) and dynamic (Claim 4) treat the sandbox's "Uses Task Scheduler COM API" signature as run-side support that the persistence path executed, while the same platform, same run, same signature set dismisses the co-located severity-8 "Active Setup", the VSS WMI/COM pair, the hook/WriteProcessMemory items and "Checks SCSI registry key(s)" as unproven. My raw data supports neither side of that split: no task, mutex or registry artifact was captured, no cmd/wmic child process appears, and — decisively — no C2 attempt exists anywhere on the wire, while the file carries init gates that abort before the beacon starts [ev_0166]. I therefore reject crediting the task-COM signature as executed behaviour: T1053.005 stands on the decompiled code alone (capability, execution unconfirmed), and Active Setup/VSS/hooks must be treated as equally unproven rather than as a lower tier. Evidence: [ev_0014][ev_0277][ev_0278][ev_0279][ev_0281][ev_0309][ev_0310][ev_0166].

- **`:wtfbbq` as the mutex/named object.** As delivered to me, static_r2's Claim 12 still couples `:wtfbbq`@0x3a99 with the imported `CreateMutexW` (my own round-0 Claim 37 also listed it as a candidate). I reject that coupling: the code passes the wide blob 0x1360bc0fa00 → `runnung` to the CreateMutexW slot with the 0xB7 abort; `:wtfbbq` has no demonstrated named-object use. (The mediator reports this superseded; it is recorded so downstream never writes `:wtfbbq` as the mutex name.) Evidence: [ev_0166][ev_0169][ev_0198][ev_0019].

- **Association of the two ~600-byte `.dat` writes (and the dropped set) with the sample.** I reject any association — including dynamic's residual "consistent with the sample's staging templates" phrasing — because the provenance record gives a Windows package-cache path (StartMenuExperienceHost TempState), a shell-process record and ≈422 s timing, with no attribution to the sample shown anywhere; the sample's own templates do not connect to it. (Converges with static_r2's and network's rejection.) Evidence: [ev_0015][ev_0297][ev_0281][ev_0019].

- **Exclusion of the reversing stage's input.** The mediator states all_tools_reverser_ghidra "failed with an AnalystError and is therefore excluded"; my run state says the reversing stage ran, and its report with decompiled routines is in front of me and cited above [ev_0143]–[ev_0243]. I dispute the exclusion: the stage's input should be carried as degraded-but-available (individual tool calls failed, not the contribution), with the single-source caveats noted per claim — dropping it would discard the only code-level evidence for the decoder, the dispatch tree, the gates and the in-process execution path. Evidence: [ev_0143][ev_0152][ev_0166][ev_0168][ev_0179][ev_0186][ev_0132][ev_0222].

DISPUTES recorded as above (4). No further disagreements: file-type label, packer boolean, YARA-corpus difference, language label, empty ATT&CK map and inventory-scope differences are resolved as different-scope measurements; I concur with the settled core (decoder mechanism, two `/live/` endpoints and protocol, the rundll32 ordinal-#1 load, no embedded second stage, and family held only as an external claim).
